mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are looking at 49 degrees and clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, though please be aware of an air quality index of 53 under our current Full Moon.

The City of Verona has announced that a section of Highway M will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for paving work. Additionally, please be vigilant against email scams requesting payment for planning fees as the city only accepts checks at City Hall.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market occurring today, along with live music performances scheduled for today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look back, on September 5, a driver was arrested for an O W I offence and other traffic violations after being stopped for speeding 83 miles per hour on the highway.
You can treat yourself to today's delicious flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
